$comment: Workflows are configured by people in the GoHighLevel workflow builder, not by the website. Trigger and action names must be matched to the GHL UI (NEEDS CONFIRMATION). No workflow sends marketing messages without mm_consent_marketing = true.

transactionalAllowed: reply to the inquiry the visitor submitted
booking confirmations and reminders the visitor requested
globalRules.loopPrevention: No workflow adds the tag that triggers another workflow it is triggered by. Every workflow has 'allow re-entry' OFF unless stated.
globalRules.quietHours: NEEDS CONFIRMATION (Gulf Standard Time business hours)

workflows.trigger: Opportunity created in pipeline 'Sales — New Business' at stage 'New Lead' (or tag mm:web-inquiry added)

steps.action: Assign opportunity owner by division (routing table)
Internal notification to owner (email/app) with a link to the opportunity
Send acknowledgement email to the contact (transactional: 'we received your inquiry')
Create task 'First contact within 1 business day' for the owner
If stage still 'New Lead' after 1 business day → notify owner and the sales lead

workflows.trigger: Appointment booked on the 'Discovery call' calendar

steps.action: Move opportunity to 'Discovery Scheduled' (find the open opportunity for the contact)
Confirmation email with meeting details and a reschedule link

branches.noShow: Mark appointment no-show → task for owner to follow up once; no automated chasing beyond one message

steps.action: If there is no response after 14 business days, notify the owner only. Stages are moved by people, never by this workflow.

workflows.note: Follow-ups are tasks for people, not automated emails, to avoid sending stale messages.

steps.action: Create opportunity in pipeline 'Client Onboarding' at 'Kickoff Scheduled' (only if none open for this contact)
Welcome email (transactional) from the account owner
Send project intake form link (GHL form or external tool — NEEDS CONFIRMATION)
Internal tasks: contract/invoice check, access & assets checklist, kickoff booking

workflows.status: NEEDS CONFIRMATION (contracts, invoicing, project management tool)

workflows.trigger: Opportunity in 'Contacting' with no activity for 10 business days
conditions: mm_consent_marketing not required (it is a reply to their own inquiry)

steps.action: One polite follow-up email: 'Is this still a priority?'
If no reply after 10 more business days → status lost, reason no-response
Status lost, reason other; tag mm:do-not-contact; remove from all workflows
